memoryBuilder.verseText: God said: 'It is not good to be alone.'

application.question: God made us to be close to Him and close to each other. Who will you be close to today?
application.followUp: God walked in the garden with the very first people. He made you for that same closeness — with Him, and with the people He has given you. You were never meant to be alone.
